notes.title: RITW Update 0.405
notes.content:
[h1]6 SAVE GAME SLOTS![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27668626/85c522c4f73048fc790ebacf067a31e2f8c6cab7.png[/img]

Some people wanted to be able to save more than one Save Game. Well now you can Save up to 6 Games! That's enough for mom, dad, sis, bro, dog, and you! The whole family can Save a Game!

I would LOVE to hear ANY suggestions for Robots In The Wild. Head over to the forums and yell them at me. :)
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/501270/discussions/]Forums[/url]

Also...
Monsters die cooler if you're final shot is their head.
Added shiny Extreme Rescue Medallions for completing Extreme Rescue Planets

notes.title: RITW Update 0.404
notes.content:
[h1]FAST FORWARD BUTTON![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27668626/065ca7f0a47b30145fbc34f2a3df3d7d4924950e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27668626/7ed58ec45a8d2a3a3f31a6f798b43265ba4d1506.png[/img]

Some people say that this game is too hard. Other people are so good that they need the game to come at them quicker! Enter the FAST FORWARD BUTTON. Simply click to make the game world speed up and try to kill you faster.

Also...
Robots now shake when firing guns or completing builds.
Robots now shake when being attacked.

notes.title: Robots in the Wild combines Pipe Mania with Tetris
notes.content: Robots in the Wild [official site] is a cute puzzle game about building forts out of blocks on strange planets by dropping blocks into formation. It’s kind of part Pipe Mania, part Tetris with some charming mouth-trumpety sound effects. … [visit site to read more]
